outcome: average number of drugs prescribed per encounter
percentage of drugs prescribed by generic name
percentage of encounters with an injection
percentage of drugs prescribed from the essential drug list
cohort: 960 indoor patients treated under CMAAY/PMJAY insurance schemes at Tomo Riba Institute of Health and Medical Sciences in Arunachal Pradesh between June 2020 and December 2020.
finding: The percentage of prescriptions with a high average number of drugs per prescription, antibiotic use, and injection use were higher than WHO core prescribing indicators, potentially due to the inclusion of post-operative patients.
